I’ve been learning swimming at Michael Phelps Swimming – Kohinoor Club for the last 6 months, and the experience has been amazing!

featured_reviews.name: greta rebello
featured_reviews.review_text: Clean and well maintained facility, very helpful staff's,  always alert lifeguard's, very professional, knowledgeable, encouraging, motivating and most importantly very understanding coaches and a highly alert head coach with an eagle's eye on every student and coach. Swimming lessons are given in a very professional manner keeping in mind every student's comfort level in water. Like to thank Coach Navdeep for understanding my spine disc buldge, severe Sciatica pain and water phobia issue and training me accordingly starting with simple water exercise. I would like to thank coach Rohit sir too for switching me to breaststroke swimming keeping in mind my repetitive Spine, Sciatica pain and leg cramps issues. Feedback from Coaches and encouragement from head coach Mr Abhijeet Pane sir keeps us motivated to help my Son learn more swimming and encourage others too to learn Swimming. My Son is enjoying his Competitive level swimming lessons under Coach Shubhankar. He pays attention to every stroke, movement, speed and breathing techniques. My son is motivated to learn more  Swimming in a very professional and competitive manner under coach Shubhankar.

featured_reviews.name: Irfan Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
I joined the swimming program at Michael Phelps Swimming India, Kohinoor Club Kurla, expecting a professional and hygienic environment, but unfortunately my experience was disappointing.

The biggest concern is cleanliness and hygiene. The washroom areas are not maintained properly and often feel unhygienic. The pool maintenance also needs serious improvement. Additionally, there is no proper shade or sun protection around the pool area, making it uncomfortable during peak daytime sessions.

Another issue is the lack of proper team management and professionalism among some staff members. There seems to be poor coordination between coaches, and arguments or conflicts happening in front of students create an uncomfortable environment. Some coaches also appear uninterested and non-cooperative during sessions, which affects the overall learning experience.

There were also occasions where staff members appeared to consume tobacco products before or during sessions, which created an unpleasant environment due to strong odor and felt highly unprofessional around students and parents.

Communication is another challenge due to language barriers, and overall the atmosphere feels poorly managed for a place that represents such a reputed name.

I hope the management takes these concerns seriously and improves the hygiene, professionalism, discipline, and overall experience for students and parents.

featured_reviews.name: Mohammad Asif Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text: Had an amazing experience learning swimming with Coach Shubhankar Sir! 🏊‍♂️ His coaching style is super patient, motivating, and focused on technique. He pays attention to every detail and helps you overcome your fears in the water. Each session is fun, challenging, and confidence-boosting. Highly recommend him to anyone wanting to improve their swimming skills!

featured_reviews.name: Toufiq Sayed
featured_reviews.review_text:
I opted in for their swimming programme last year and had a good experience overall- very professional and friendly trainers.

However, I wish they'd structure the programme to start by teaching basic survival in water first, instead of directly starting with freestyle and other swimming techniques.

Because midway through the programme I started having neck pain which further led  to the discovery that I had a neck issue since birth but it was passive till my neck started getting engaged a lot as part of learning the swimming techniques.
So I had to stop before I could learn basic survival in water which was my primary goal of joining the programme.

featured_reviews.name: vaishno gupta
featured_reviews.review_text:
My daughter has been learning swimming at MPS– Kohinoor Club for the last 3 months, and the experience has been great 👍

The entire coaching team is highly skilled and motivating. Special mention to Amravati Ma'am, she had a great experience learning swimming basics under her guidance. In just 3 sessions, she helped my daughter overcome her fear of water and understand the fundamentals clearly.
Their focus on proper technique, perfection, and building confidence truly makes learning enjoyable. 🏊‍♂️💙
She now feels much more confident in the water.

Highly recommended for beginners!❤️

featured_reviews.name: Onkar Sudrik
featured_reviews.review_text:
After just two classes, I’m genuinely amazed at how much I’ve already learned with Prashant sir. In such a short time, he’s taught me floating, gliding, leg movements, and even proper hand techniques—far more than I expected to pick up so quickly, especially since I have limited days to learn swimming.

What truly sets Prashant sir apart is his clear and effective communication. He explains every technique in a simple, practical way that instantly makes sense. More importantly, his teaching style builds confidence and independence rather than dependency. After every session, I come away feeling, “Yes, I can actually do this.”

Thanks to his patience and structured approach, I’m now genuinely confident that I’ll be able to learn swimming within the short timeframe I have. An excellent coach—highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: Shaili Sanghvi
featured_reviews.review_text: My daughter who is 3 yrs old was enrolled at the pre beginner level 3 months ago, after 21 sessions the staff got completely changed and the students nor the parents were told of this situation. Now the new teachers are teaching again from the basics instead of taking the child's progress ahead. There is no head coach to talk to nor does the head office reply to the emails. I do not recommend this franchise of Micheal Phelps Swimming to anybody.

featured_reviews.name: Supreme Kothari
featured_reviews.review_text:
The idea of personal coaching during a 40-minute session here seems to run entirely on luck—and unfortunately, luck doesn’t favor everyone every day. Like today, for instance—my daughter got a few seconds of attention right at the end, while the coach’s focus remained firmly on a younger child throughout. Maybe there’s a secret lottery system? If so, we’d love to know how to sign up.

Also, during rains (like on 1st June), it’s perfectly normal here for most coaches to simply step out while kids are left to figure things out on their own. Because, of course, why would Michael Phelps’ name imply any higher standard, especially in India?

And yes, batch change chaos is part of life—we get that. But if it regularly eats into actual swimming time, then it stops being "chaos" and starts becoming bad planning.

If there’s some unofficial premium fee that buys actual attention, please do let us know. We'd be happy to pay, instead of just crossing our fingers each time.

We expected the name to come with certain standards. Right now, it feels more like a branding exercise than a coaching one.

featured_reviews.name: kiran karande
featured_reviews.review_text:
“Michael Phelps Swimming Academy at Universal Chembur is an absolute gem for anyone looking to dive into the world of swimming, from beginners to advanced swimmers alike. The facility is meticulously maintained, offering a clean, hygienic environment that’s immediately welcoming and sets the tone for a safe and enjoyable swimming experience. The pool itself is beautifully designed and well-equipped, making it ideal for swimmers of all levels.

The coaching staff is truly top-notch, with well-trained instructors who bring patience, expertise, and personalized attention to each swimmer. The academy follows the Michael Phelps method, ensuring that techniques are taught correctly with a strong focus on form and safety. The coaches are approachable, motivating, and skilled in working with everyone from young children to adults, adapting their approach based on the needs and skill levels of each participant. For those who might be a bit nervous or lack confidence in the water, the coaches are fantastic at building trust and helping swimmers gradually overcome their fears.

The pool’s water quality is exceptional, as it is regularly tested and maintained, ensuring a pleasant swimming experience without the overpowering smell of chlorine that some pools can have. The entire space, from the pool to the changing areas, is kept extremely clean, adding to the sense of professionalism and care that the facility offers.

The management at Universal Chembur has clearly invested in creating a high-quality swimming experience. They provide all necessary amenities, and there’s a strong emphasis on safety, with lifeguards always on duty and clear guidelines for both swimmers and spectators. The academy also offers convenient scheduling options, so whether you’re looking for early morning sessions or evening classes, there’s something to fit a variety of schedules.

I will not recommend this pool to anyone who has a sensitive skin or is prone to skin issues.
I joined this Jan 2026 ,for 3  months .The pool always gave me skin problems and cold allergies.They don't let you wear a closed outfit ,there are very particular about ,keeping sleeves and leggings short.They prefer that you wear 1 piece.
The trainers are very good .I have been going in the ladies timeslots and I find them very connected.
I have had to spend nearly Rs.5000, totally on 2 instances  for skin care treatment with Drs.  medications ,creams  in a span of 2 months ,in April this year I have not bothered to renew.
They show they are maintaining but nothing is happening,and itseems this is a very old issue .They have a whataspp group where ladies are complaining and taking action regularly,sadly it is not effective.
All in the name of BMC swimming pool.
I think there are using excess of chlorine ,which also makes the skin ,hair,mouth, chapped lips and irritating teeth, dry and scratchy skin post the swim .
Even after medication and application of creams tan lotion etc ,the moment you swim for 15 minutes in the pool ,you will realize all the above symptoms.
Please consider before you join,thinking that the rates are very normal and not very expensive like other clubs,but this filtration issue itself is a major concern.
They closed the pool.for almost 1 week in April and off and on the pool remains closed .These days will be compensated in your membership times pan.
Sad but true .

featured_reviews.name: adhishtha parmar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Don’t fall for the positive reviews. They are all fake.

I had an extremely disappointing experience at Workout World. The equipment is outdated and poorly maintained, making my workouts far from enjoyable. The gym is always overcrowded and congested. The owner and receptionist are shockingly rude and clearly lack customer service skills. Despite their subpar facilities, they have the audacity to charge premium rates. I must mention Sheetal, who is utterly lacking in manners and professionalism and is the most pathetic receptionist I have come across. Save yourself the frustration and avoid this place at all costs. They are greedy and have zero consideration for old clients as well.  They hiked up personal training rates by a whopping 60% overnight. Steer clear of this gym – it's not worth the headache or the expense.

Furthermore, it's clear that the folks at Workout World have completely missed the memo that their gym is functional because of their customers. Instead, they display an arrogant and dismissive attitude towards paying clients. No matter how fancy the name may sound, it's the customer experience that truly matters, and Workout World clearly does not care about that

featured_reviews.name: Rehan Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
The gym is good however few things that needs to be fixed.

1st) the changing room needs to have mirror and proper lighting so that you can take post workout progress photos.

2nd) Gym needs to be open atleast until 11:30 Pm in the night.

3rd) I don't understand the need to write in/out time on the gym register, its just very old fashioned.

featured_reviews.name: Narendra Mehra
featured_reviews.review_text: This place is located on the ground floor of a residential building in Sunder Nagar Kalina Santa Cruz east. Good workout place for locals. Road in front is generally crowded and the traffic is chaotic as there are a host of residential buildings in the vicinity. Appears to have good equipment for training and workouts. There are also a number of similar places available in the neighborhood within tow to three kilometers range. Take your pick.
